Definition: Jebus, the original name of Jerusalem
BiblicalUsage: Jebus is the old name of Jerusalem, the city the Jebusites held before David took it. David and all Israel went to Jerusalem, which is Jebus, and the Levite on his way to Gibeah came over against Jebus, which is Jerusalem.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe God takes the city of the enemy and makes it His own, and Jebus became Jerusalem when David took it. My position is that the old name is not erased but remembered, so that the conquest is never forgotten.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
